problem.source: Pick Postmark, SendGrid, Mailgun, Notifuse or files.
problem.fullAddress: Use the full address, like https://notifuse.example.com.
problem.onlyAddress: Use only the instance's address, like https://notifuse.example.com: no credentials, query or fragment.

problem.privateAddress.message: That address is on a private or internal network. Turn on providers.allow_private_networks to import from a server there.
problem.privateAddress.note: providers.allow_private_networks is a setting's name: keep it

problem.noFiles: Add at least one MJML or HTML file.

problem.tooManyFiles.message: Upload up to {max} files at a time.

problem.fileType: only .mjml, .html and .htm files can be imported
problem.noKey: This import has no API key any more. Start again and paste the key.
problem.sealed: The stored API key can't be decrypted. Start again and paste the key.
problem.finished: This import is finished. Start a new one to import more templates.
problem.filesConverted: Uploaded files are converted when they are uploaded.
problem.convertFirst: Convert the templates first; this import has nothing to bring in yet.

source.unreachable.note: name: the provider (Postmark); reason: what the network answered, in English

source.notFound.note: detail: the provider's own answer, as it wrote it

source.rateLimited: {name} is rate-limiting requests (429). Try again in a minute.

source.unavailable.message: {name} answered {status}. Try again in a few minutes.

source.refused.note: code: an HTTP status code; detail: the provider's own answer

source.redirect.message: {name} redirects to another address ({status}). Enter the address it answers at.

source.unreadable.message: {name} sent an answer ReputeCast can't read: {detail}.
source.unreadable.note: detail: the parser's finding, in English

auth.mailgun.message: Mailgun answered {code}: the API key is wrong, or the account is in the other region.

auth.notifuse: Notifuse answered {code}: the API key was revoked or belongs to another instance.
auth.postmark: Postmark answered {code}: this token is for a different server or was revoked.

auth.sendgridTemplates.message: SendGrid answered 403: this key can't read templates. Give it Template Engine read access.
auth.sendgridTemplates.note: Template Engine is SendGrid's permission's name

auth.sendgrid: SendGrid answered {code}: the API key was revoked or is mistyped.
mailgun.domainOnly: Enter the sending domain only, like mg.acme.io.
mailgun.noDomains: This Mailgun account has no domains, so it has no templates to import.
mailgun.noTemplate: That template isn't in this Mailgun account.
notifuse.address: Enter the address of your Notifuse instance, for example https://notifuse.example.com.
notifuse.noWorkspace: This Notifuse API key isn't attached to a workspace.

summary.variables.message: {count, plural, =0 {No variables} =1 {1 variable declared: {first}} =2 {2 variables declared: {first}, {second}} other {# variables declared}}
summary.variables.note: the report's Notes cell when nothing needs attention; first, second: variable names

note.mjml.note: a report note (they start in lowercase after the template's name); detail: the MJML compiler's finding, in English

note.viewInBrowser: transactional mail has no web version, so `view_in_browser_url` prints nothing. Remove the link.

note.renamed.message: `{from}` became `{to}`: variable names use letters, digits and underscores, so your app sends `{to}` in data.
note.renamed.note: from, to: variable names; text in backticks is code

note.idTaken.message: The ID `{want}` exists, so it arrives as `{key}`.
note.idTaken.note: want, key: template IDs, password-reset and password-reset-2

note.notReturned.note: source: the provider; reason: its answer, in English

note.fileNoTitle: the file has no title, so the subject is empty. Write one before publishing.
note.mailgunSubject: Mailgun keeps the subject in each call, not in the template, so it is empty. Write one before publishing.

note.mailgunEngine.message: this version uses Mailgun's {engine} engine, which ReputeCast can't convert. Rewrite its tags in Liquid.

note.postmarkLayoutUnread: its layout `{layout}` couldn't be read, so the email has no header or footer. Add them with saved sections.
note.postmarkLayoutMerged: its layout “{name}” was merged into the email.
note.notifuseEmpty: this template has no email content in Notifuse.

note.notifuseLayout.message: its visual editor layout couldn't be read, so it arrives as HTML: {detail}.
note.notifuseLayout.note: detail: the reader's finding, in English

note.notifuseLiquidBlock: Notifuse's Liquid block became an `mj-raw` block with the same code.

note.notifuseBlocks.message: these Notifuse blocks have no MJML equivalent and were left out: {names}.
note.notifuseBlocks.note: names: block types in backticks, joined with commas

note.sendgridVersion: no version is active in SendGrid, so “{name}” was imported.

note.partial.message: the {dialect} partial `{src}` has no Liquid equivalent. Use a saved section.
note.partial.note: dialect: Mustachio or Handlebars; src: the template code

note.delimiters: `{src}` changes the tag delimiters, which Liquid can't do. Rewrite the tags that follow with `'{{ }}'`.
note.rawBlock: the raw block `{src}` has no Liquid equivalent. Use `'{%' raw %'}'`.
note.unreadable: `{src}` isn't an expression ReputeCast can read.

note.became.note: src, out: the template code before and after

note.date.message: `{src}` became `{out}`.{offset, select, none {} other { Liquid prints the time in the zone the value carries, so the offset {offset} was left out.}}{unknown, select, none {} other { These format tokens have no Liquid equivalent and print as written: {unknown}.}}
note.date.note: a date helper's conversion; offset: the offset the helper had (none for none); unknown: format tokens Liquid doesn't have (none for none)

note.mailgunEqual: `{src}` became `'{%' if {left} == {right} %'}'`. Mailgun compares the values as text; Liquid also compares their type, so send both as text.
note.emptyPasses: `{src}` became `'{%' if {cond} %'}'`. Liquid counts empty text as a value, so an empty one now passes.
note.noEquivalentInLoop: `{src}` has no Liquid equivalent in a loop.
note.section: the section `{src}` became `'{%' if {cond} %'}'`; names inside it now start with `{liq}.`.
note.with: `{src}` became `'{%' if {cond} %'}'`; names inside it now start with `{liq}.`.
note.mailgunOther: Mailgun's `{src}` has no ReputeCast equivalent. Send the value in the call's data and print it with `'{{ }}'`.
note.closesUnopened: `{src}` closes a block that was never opened.
note.include: `'{%' {name} %'}'` has no ReputeCast equivalent: templates can't include other files. Use a saved section.
note.liquidTag: the Liquid tag `{name}` isn't available in ReputeCast.
note.liquidFilter: the Liquid filter `{name}` isn't available in ReputeCast.
note.contactField: `{field}` became `{name}`: transactional mail has no contact profile, so the call sends it in its data.
note.confirmSubscription: `confirm_subscription_url` belongs to Notifuse's double opt-in emails. ReputeCast sends its own confirmations.
note.listField: `{field}` has no value in transactional mail: it isn't sent to a list.
why.root: `@root` prints the whole data, which Liquid can't do.
why.outerLoop: `{path}` refers to an outer loop, which Liquid can't reach.
why.topLevel: `{path}` at the top level prints the whole data, which Liquid can't do.
why.notPath: `{path}` isn't a path Liquid can read.
why.notName: `{path}` isn't a name Liquid can read.
why.subexpression: this subexpression has no Liquid equivalent.
why.hash: hash arguments have no Liquid equivalent.
